scheme_name: Maharashtra Employment Guarantee Scheme (Rojgar Hami Yojana)
department: Employment Guarantee Scheme Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Guarantees unskilled manual employment on public works to rural households in Maharashtra, the state-level precursor/complement to MGNREGA.
benefits: Guaranteed wage employment on public works for registered rural households, subject to the state's guarantee period.
eligibility: Rural household in Maharashtra willing to do unskilled manual work
application_steps: Register with the Gram Panchayat to obtain a job card
